import collections, copy, hashlib, json, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
OUT=ROOT/"evidence/quality/functor_shell_pr"
def git(*args):return subprocess.check_output(["git",*args],cwd=ROOT)
def digest(raw):return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
base=git("rev-parse","origin/main").decode().strip()
head=git("rev-parse","HEAD").decode().strip()
replay=json.loads((OUT/"replay.json").read_bytes())
for path,sha in replay["source_snapshot"].items():
 assert digest((ROOT/"code/rust/src/category_theory"/path).read_bytes())==sha,path
for p,sha in replay["sources"].items():
 assert (ROOT/p).read_bytes()==git("show","HEAD:"+p) and b"\r" not in (ROOT/p).read_bytes()
 assert digest((ROOT/p).read_bytes())==sha
baseline=json.loads((ROOT/"governance/baseline.json").read_bytes())
oldbase=json.loads(git("show",base+":governance/baseline.json"))
assert baseline["entries"].keys()==oldbase["entries"].keys()
diff=[p for p in baseline["entries"] if baseline["entries"][p]!=oldbase["entries"][p]]
assert set(diff)==set(replay["sources"])
for p in diff:assert baseline["entries"][p]["sha256"]==replay["sources"][p]
protected=["dag","lean4","atlas","papers","governance/policy.json","docs/overclaim/baseline.json"]
assert not git("diff","--name-only",base,"--",*protected)
audit=json.loads((ROOT/"dag/pfp/prompt_audit.json").read_bytes())
prompt_paths=[n["prompt"] for n in audit["nodes"]]
assert len(prompt_paths)==len(set(prompt_paths))==audit["prompts_reviewed"]
# Full prompt blob preservation implies preservation of every sealed payload.
assert not git("diff","--name-only",base,"--",*prompt_paths)
hist={}
for name in ["functor","full_functor"]:
 path=f"code/rust/src/category_theory/functor/{name}.contract.score.yaml"
 d=json.loads((ROOT/path).read_bytes())
 old=json.loads(git("show","11c1123d6cee59b98cc036202d487d89a84b0283:"+path))
 for kind in ["contract_history","scoring_history"]:
  assert d[kind][:len(old[kind])]==old[kind]
 hist[name]={k:{"previous":len(old[k]),"current":len(d[k])} for k in ["contract_history","scoring_history"]}
 current=next(e["record"] for e in d["scoring_history"] if e["sha256"]==d["current_scoring"])
 assert current["score_token"]=="L2D" and current["gates"]=={"G1":"C","G2":"C","G3":"C","G4":"D","G5":"D"}
 # All raw source-record bytes and evidence bindings are independently checked.
 for k in ["contract_history","scoring_history"]:
  for e in d[k]:
   raw=e["raw_utf8"].encode()
   assert digest(raw)==e["sha256"] and len(raw)==e["bytes"]
 for e in [*d["contract"]["evidence"],*current["evidence"]]:
  assert digest((ROOT/e["path"]).read_bytes())==e["sha256"]
dag=json.loads((ROOT/"dag/derivation_dag.json").read_bytes())
r={"AuthorityEffect":"None","base":base,"source_tree_commit":head,
 "sources":replay["sources"],"committed_LF_blobs_match":True,
 "complete_category_snapshot_still_matches_replay":True,
 "baseline_changed_entries":diff,"other_baseline_entries_unchanged":len(baseline["entries"])-len(diff),
 "protected_paths_unchanged":protected,"sealed_prompt_blobs_unchanged":len(prompt_paths),
 "derivation_dag_sha256":digest((ROOT/"dag/derivation_dag.json").read_bytes()),
 "unchanged_node_statuses":len(dag["nodes"]),"histories_preserved":hist,
 "source_functions":{n:sum(1 for line in (ROOT/f"code/rust/src/category_theory/functor/{n}.rs").read_text().split("#[cfg(test)]")[0].splitlines() if __import__("re").search(r"\bfn \w+",line)) for n in ["functor","full_functor"]},
 "source_unit_tests":{n:(ROOT/f"code/rust/src/category_theory/functor/{n}.rs").read_text().count("#[test]") for n in ["functor","full_functor"]}}
(OUT/"custody.json").write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8",newline="\n")
print(json.dumps(r,indent=2))
